name: Fond Naše Česko
aliases: Fond Naše Česko J&T Investiční společnosti
decision_note: Qualified-investor open-end fund of J&T Investiční společnost focused on Czech assets - mainly listed Czech shares and bonds, with startup and company stakes largely through related funds - so a listed-securities strategy (E3) despite one direct co-investment in ValkaAI's pre-seed (Feb 2026).

evidence.quote: Nakupuje akcie českých firem, a to nejen na české burze, ale třeba i v Londýně, kam umístil cenné papíry Martin Vohánka se svým Eurowagem .
Fond Naše Česko má ambici nasbírat od investorů během tří let až 1,5 miliardy korun a plánuje dosahovat průměrného ročního zhodnocení kolem 12 procent.

a to od tuzemských fondů J&T Ventures, Tensor Ventures, BD Partners (za nímž stojí někdejší spolupracovníci Petra Kellnera Ladislav Bartoníček a Jean-Pascal Duvieusart ), Fondu Naše Česko J&T Investiční společnosti a právě Rockaway Ventures, který kolo vedl.

analyst_notes: J&T opened the fund in 2023 for qualified investors (minimum about CZK 1m), with the aim of raising up to CZK 1.5bn in three years (target, not capital); portfolio manager Martin Cakl (ex-SPM family office). Strategy per CzechCrunch 2023-09-12: Czech listed shares (Prague and London, e.g. Eurowag), participation in startup and corporate investments through related funds, real estate exposure via CPI group bonds. Dominant activity is listed equities/bonds, so E3 (investor_type left null as for other E3 records); the only direct startup deal seen is ValkaAI's EUR 12m pre-seed led by Rockaway Ventures (Feb 2026, round total), which falls in the activity window - re-screen as a VC-type investor only if the fund turns out to invest mainly in private companies. ARES lists 'Naše ČESKO otevřený podílový fond' (75164086, est. 2023-03-31) at J&T IS's address. The fund's own J&T page was not retrieved (web search budget exhausted), so no class B source; quote e1 keeps the page's space before the full stop. Quote e3 is the second half of one sentence (full sentence exceeds 300 characters); its first half gives the EUR 12m pre-seed amount.
